```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

df <- read_excel("C:/Users/syknd/OneDrive/ドキュメント/syknd.github.io/410-df_panel_selected_90.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.character(year),
    total_text_language =
      kw_pollution_ecosystem_lag +
      kw_climate_emissions_lag +
      kw_action_investment_lag +
      kw_sustainability_core_lag +
      kw_governance_reporting_lag +
      kw_energy_resources_lag
  )
```

# Overview

## Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Companies"

list(
  icon = "building",
  color = "primary",
  value = n_distinct(df$Ticker)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Observations"

list(
  icon = "table",
  color = "info",
  value = nrow(df)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average E Score"

list(
  icon = "leaf",
  color = "success",
  value = round(mean(df$e_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Sectors"

list(
  icon = "diagram-3",
  color = "warning",
  value = n_distinct(df$GICSSector)
)
```

## Row {height=75%}

```{r}
#| title: "Sustainability Language vs. Environmental Score"

p <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(
    x = total_text_language,
    y = e_score,
    color = GICSSector,
    text = paste(
      "Ticker:", Ticker,
      "<br>Year:", year,
      "<br>Sector:", GICSSector,
      "<br>Environmental Score:", round(e_score, 2),
      "<br>Total Sustainability Language:", round(total_text_language, 4)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Total Sustainability Language",
    y = "Environmental Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

# Sector Patterns

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Average Environmental Score by Sector"

sector_e <- df |>
  group_by(GICSSector) |>
  summarise(
    average_e_score = mean(e_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(average_e_score)

p <- ggplot(
  sector_e,
  aes(
    x = average_e_score,
    y = reorder(GICSSector, average_e_score),
    text = paste(
      "Sector:", GICSSector,
      "<br>Average E Score:", round(average_e_score, 2)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Average Environmental Score",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Average Sustainability Language by Sector"

sector_text <- df |>
  group_by(GICSSector) |>
  summarise(
    average_text = mean(total_text_language, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(average_text)

p <- ggplot(
  sector_text,
  aes(
    x = average_text,
    y = reorder(GICSSector, average_text),
    text = paste(
      "Sector:", GICSSector,
      "<br>Average Sustainability Language:", round(average_text, 4)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Average Sustainability Language",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

# ESG Breakdown

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Average ESG Scores by Sector"

esg_long <- df |>
  group_by(GICSSector) |>
  summarise(
    Environmental = mean(e_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Social = mean(s_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Governance = mean(g_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Environmental, Social, Governance),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "average_score"
  )

p <- ggplot(
  esg_long,
  aes(
    x = average_score,
    y = reorder(GICSSector, average_score),
    fill = score_type,
    text = paste(
      "Sector:", GICSSector,
      "<br>Score Type:", score_type,
      "<br>Average Score:", round(average_score, 2)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Score",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Score Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
